item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel A: The 2026-10-06 entry for this record said the 2042 date comes from the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance. That was wrong. The Port's 2017 staff report (Item 9B, p.7) puts the Schedule of Performance in the Disposition and Development Agreement (DDA) between the Port and the developer, which is a different agreement from the Development Agreement between the City and the developer. The report says the developer must complete phase 3 within approximately 25 years of project approval, but it never states the year 2042; 2042 is Pier & Point's own arithmetic (2017 plus 25 years). It stays labelled a legal outside date, not an expected completion.
